cohort_total_n_excerpt: Cases were 219 patients, aged 45 to 59 years, with histologically confirmed prostate cancer, and controls were 431 men of the same age group, admitted in hospital for acute, non-neoplastic diseases.
reason: The study analyzes prostate cancer risk in cases and controls without reporting an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: No association emerged with marital status, body mass index, history of diabetes, alcohol drinking, and other considered foods.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol finding concerns prostate cancer risk generally, with no aggressive subtype specified.
